blocks.x: The Tomorrow evening on Channel 8, WYES-TV and the NET Festival of the Arts proudly present Igor Stravinsky. The first half of this 90-minute profile on Stravinsky will be a thoughtful documentary on the composer's life. This former portion of the offering will compare the maestro's earlier years with his more recent ones to show how Stravinsky, now 83, is somehow as fascinating as ever. In the latter portion of the program, NET will be our host for an evening at the concert. Included in the program will be Stravinsky's Polsonella Suite, as well as the American television premiere of two of his more recent works, the cantata, Abraham and Isaac, and Elegy for JFK.
